BiblicalUsage: Mizzah is a son of Reuel, a grandson of Esau, named among the chiefs of Edom. He appears only in the genealogies, twice in Genesis and once in Chronicles, a name carried down so the family line is not lost.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a name in a list is remembered by God: Mizzah's place in the record is his whole story, and it is enough.
